# hyperfluid_grant (Resource)

A fine-grained permission granted to a user, a service account or a group, organization-wide or narrowed by `scope_path`. `effect = "deny"` withdraws the permission instead, with precedence over every allow. Grants are immutable: every argument forces a new grant.

Requires `grant:create`, `grant:read` and `grant:delete`. The same permission cannot be granted twice to one principal at one scope with one effect.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Service accounts are created in the console or with hfctl; Terraform
# references them.
data "hyperfluid_service_account" "etl" {
  client_id = "etl"
}

# Read every secret under prod/, for every member of the group.
resource "hyperfluid_grant" "data_eng_prod_secrets" {
  principal_type = "group"
  principal_id   = hyperfluid_group.data_eng.id
  permission     = "secret:read"
  scope_path     = "prod/*"
}

# A deny takes precedence over every allow.
resource "hyperfluid_grant" "etl_no_secret_updates" {
  principal_type = "service_account"
  principal_id   = data.hyperfluid_service_account.etl.id
  permission     = "secret:update"
  effect         = "deny"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission` (String) Permission key, `<resource_type>:<action>`, e.g. `secret:read`. The `hyperfluid_permissions` data source lists them.
- `principal_id` (String) Id of the user, the service account (the `hyperfluid_service_account` data source's `id`, not its `client_id`) or the group. A public-client service account cannot hold grants: the API refuses it.
- `principal_type` (String) `user`, `service_account` or `group`.

### Optional

- `effect` (String) `allow` (default) or `deny`.
- `resource_uuid` (String) Id of the one resource `scope_path` names exactly. The grant then survives a rename of the resource and is deleted with it. Requires an exact `scope_path`.
- `scope_path` (String) Path in the organization's resource tree, within the permission's resource family: exact, an ancestor folder (covers what is beneath it), or a `*`-suffixed wildcard at a path boundary (`prod/*`). Omit for an organization-wide grant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Grant id (uuid).
- `permission_id` (String) Id of the permission on this installation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import id is "<principal_type>/<principal_id>/<grant_id>": a grant is read back
# through its principal.
terraform import hyperfluid_grant.data_eng_prod_secrets group/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
